entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skeletonic Stylus , must come from a real HTTP header. The GitHub Pages deployment can't set custom headers, so we lean on the X-Frame-Options equivalent that the platform ships and on the meta-supported directives below. The two `'sha256-…'` entries pin the SSG-injected inline scripts that bootstrap the search widget and the on-page live-reload watchdog. They're emitted verbatim by shokunin v0.0.34 and don't change between builds — if the SSG ever changes them we'll see the CSP error in the browser console and update the hashes. -- keeps the page CSP-clean. -- Awọn afihan Tẹ Mu ṣiṣẹ lori kaadi eyikeyi lati tun ere idasọnu ṣe lori onigun mẹrin. Awọn kilasi ere idasọnu funrarẹ ni ohun gangan ti a fi ranṣẹ ninu skeletonic-animations.min.css — animation-name nikan ni ile-ikawe ṣeto, nitorinaa bulọọki <style> loke fi animation-duration / animation-iteration-count / animation-fill-mode ti o padanu kun ki awọn keyframes le han. A ti mu Idinku Iṣipopada ṣiṣẹ ni OS rẹ, nitorinaa awọn ibi-afẹde ni isalẹ yoo duro jẹ — iyẹn ni ihuwasi irayẹ-si v2.0.0 n ṣiṣẹ ni deede. bounce Mu ṣiṣẹ pulse Mu ṣiṣẹ shake Mu ṣiṣẹ wobble Mu ṣiṣẹ flash Mu ṣiṣẹ heartbeat Mu ṣiṣẹ jelly Mu ṣiṣẹ rubberBand Mu ṣiṣẹ fadeIn Mu ṣiṣẹ fadeInDown Mu ṣiṣẹ fadeInUp Mu ṣiṣẹ popIn Mu ṣiṣẹ rollIn Mu ṣiṣẹ flipInHorizontal Mu ṣiṣẹ zoomIn Mu ṣiṣẹ vanishIn Mu ṣiṣẹ Itọkasi kilasi Kilasi Ohun ti o ṣe .bounce Igbesẹ orisun inaro .pulse Iwọn pulse rirọ .shake Gbigbọn petele .wobble Titẹ ati igbapada .flash Imọlẹ opacity igbesẹ-meji .heartbeat Iwọn lilu-meji .jelly Fifun ati gigun .rubberBand Gigun rọba .fadeIn / .fadeOut Iyipada opacity .fadeInDown / .fadeInUp / .fadeInLeft / .fadeInRight Fade ọna .zoomIn / .zoomOut Iwọn sinu / jade kuro ni iran .popIn / .popOut Iwọn orisun + fade .rollIn / .rollOut Gbigbe + yiyi .flipInHorizontal / .flipInVertical Yiyi 3-D .vanishIn / .vanishOut Ifarahan ara Material .chameleonbackground / .chameleontext Iyipo awọ Akiyesi — ohun ti a mọ nipa v2.0.0 Awọn kilasi ere idasọnu ninu v2.0.0 ṣeto animation-name nikan. entries.content: Skip to main content Translation note (2026-04-30). v2.0.0 adds RTL support and a refreshed 2026 framework comparison. The English source is the canonical reference while these translations catch up. See https://skeletonic.io/about/ · https://skeletonic.io/components/ · https://skeletonic.io/benchmarks/ . v2.0.0 — 2026-04 (lọwọlọwọ) Ipari "imurasilẹ-itusilẹ": a11y, ẹwọn ipese, itọju ibi-ipamọ. Irayẹ-si (WCAG 2.2) $primary ti a ṣe dudu si hsl(210, 100%, 42%) fun iyatọ AA si ọrọ funfun ninu awọn bọtini / awọn aami / awọn ọna asopọ. $secondary ti a ṣe dudu si hsl(195, 100%, 33%) . A fi awọn oruka focus-visible kun lori gbogbo ẹya ibaraṣepọ. A fi @media (prefers-reduced-motion) afikun kun si modulu ere idasọnu. A fi prefers-color-scheme: dark iyipada ami kun. A fi adalu target-size(24px) kun lati ni itẹlọrun WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. A fi awọn oluranlọwọ scroll-margin focus-not-obscured kun fun awọn akọle didimu. Ikọ & ẹwọn ipese Awọn ipele cascade — gbogbo bulọọki ngbe ni bayi ninu @layer skeletonic.{reset,tokens,layout,elements,components,utilities} . CycloneDX SBOM ti a ṣẹda gẹgẹ bi apakan ti tarball npm. Awọn isuna size-limit ti a fi ipa mu ninu CI: opin 8 KB gzipped lori iwe-aṣa ipilẹ. CVE-2023-44270 (postcss line return) ti a ṣe atunṣe nipasẹ pnpm.overrides . Ẹri + fọwọsi lori opo iṣẹ tẹ npm ( --provenance --access public ). A yọ plugin stylelint-a11y ti a fi pamọ kuro ninu iṣeto lint. Itọju ibi-ipamọ & package olumulo A yọ itọsọna package/ atijọ kuro; dist/ ni orisun otitọ kan bayi fun awọn olumulo. A tun README kọ lati ṣe afihan awọn ọna fifi sori ẹrọ v2.0.0. A fi dist/ sinu adehun; a ṣẹda debug/ ti a si fi sinu gitignore. .github/workflows/npm-publish.yml tuntun ni ami-akọle wakọ. Awọn atunṣe aṣiṣe (P0) Ipadabọ oluyẹwo obi row $:after — a fi & rọpo $ aṣiṣe ninu src/stylus/components/_grid.styl . .alternate fi animation-direction: reverse ranṣẹ lairotẹlẹ dipo alternate . Orukọ .alert-* — .alert.success → .alert.alert-success lati yẹra fun ikọlu pẹlu awọn kilasi ipo. Gbogbo awọn akiyesi itusilẹ v2.0.0 lori GitHub ↗ Awọn itusilẹ atijọ v1.1.6 — imọtoto inu, awọn igbega igbarale. v1.1.5 — a fi palẹti Material kun. v1.1.0 — palẹti Tachyons + atunṣe grid. v1.0.5 — itusilẹ "atijọ" ti o kẹhin ṣaaju ayẹwo WCAG 2.2. v1.0.0 — itusilẹ gbogbo eniyan akọkọ (2018). entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Skeletonic Stylus jẹ iṣẹ-akanṣe orisun-ṣiṣi; awọn ilowosi gbogbo iwọn ni a kaabo — lati atunṣe aṣiṣe kikọ si awọn paati tuntun. Ibẹrẹ kiakia # 1. Ṣe Fork ati ṣe daakọ git clone git@github.com:YOUR-USER/skeletonic-stylus.git cd skeletonic-stylus # 2. Fi sori ẹrọ (pnpm nipasẹ corepack) corepack enable pnpm install # 3. Kọ pnpm run build # opo pipe (stylus → prettier → stylelint → autoprefixer → csso) # 4. Lint ati idanwo pnpm run lint node scripts/a11y-test.mjs Awọn apejọ Awọn orukọ ẹka: feat/nkan-kukuru , fix/nkan-kukuru , docs/nkan-kukuru . Awọn adehun: Conventional Commits . Gbogbo awọn adehun ni a fọwọsi. Stylus: aye-4 indent, ko si semicolons, fẹ $variables ju awọn nọmba idan lọ, gbogbo kilasi gbogbo eniyan ngbe ninu ipele cascade. Irayẹ-si: eyikeyi paati tuntun gbọdọ jẹrisi ibamu WCAG 2.2 AA; ṣiṣẹ node scripts/a11y-test.mjs si ifihan ṣaaju ṣiṣi PR. Isuna iwọn: iwe-aṣa ipilẹ gbọdọ wa labẹ 8 KB gzipped . Ti iyipada rẹ ba ti o lọ, ṣe alaye ninu PR. Awọn ibeere fa Ṣii ọran kan ni akọkọ fun ohunkohun ti kii ṣe kekere — o fi agbara pamọ fun atunṣe. Jẹ ki awọn PR dojukọ: iyipada ọgbọn kan fun PR kan. Ṣe imudojuiwọn CHANGELOG.md labẹ "Ti a ko ti tu silẹ". Ri daju pe CI jẹ alawọ ewe ṣaaju beere fun atunyẹwo. Squash-merge ni aiyipada; awọn ifiranṣẹ adehun ni a yoo ṣe mimọ ni ọna asopọ. Koodu iwa Nipa kopa, o gba lati tẹle Contributor Covenant 2.1 . Jẹ onirẹlẹ, jẹ onisuuru, ro ero rere. Ṣii ọran ↗ · Ṣii PR ↗ ↑ ↓ Navigate ↵ Open Esc Close

entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Iṣẹ-ṣiṣe 40.6 KB minified · 8.0 KB gzipped · 6.9 KB brotli fun iwe-aṣa ipilẹ ni kikun. JavaScript kankan — Stylus mimọ → CSS mimọ, ko si iye owo iṣiṣẹ. Ti a fi cascade-layer ṣe — awọn atunṣe bori laisi !important . Isuna size-limit ti a fi ipa mu ninu CI lori adehun kọọkan. Iṣẹ-ṣiṣe jẹ iṣakoso aabo. Baiti kọọkan ti a ko fi ranṣẹ jẹ baiti kan ti o dinku lati ṣe ayẹwo, fọwọsi, ati ṣe idaniloju. Ẹwọn ipese ni ṣoki Iṣakoso Ipo v2.0.0 CycloneDX SBOM Ti a ṣẹda lori itusilẹ kọọkan, ti a fi sinu dist/sbom.json Ẹri npm Ti a mu ṣiṣẹ ( --provenance --access public ) Awọn ami git ti a fọwọsi SSH-signed nipasẹ bọtini olutọju Dependabot ti a fi idi mulẹ Awọn imudojuiwọn ọsẹ, ti a ṣe atunyẹwo ni aifọwọyi Awọn isuna iwọn size-limit opin 8 KB gzipped, kuna CI lori ipadabọ Lint stylelint + awọn idaniloju a11y lori igbewọle kọọkan CodeQL Ti a mu ṣiṣẹ fun javascript ati awọn faili iṣeto CVE-2023-44270 Ti a ṣe atunṣe nipasẹ pnpm.overrides ti o mu postcss@7 ṣe imudojuiwọn CycloneDX SBOM Gbogbo tarball ti a tẹ jade pẹlu CycloneDX SBOM ni dist/sbom.json . O le ṣayẹwo package ti a fi sori ẹrọ tuntun pẹlu: pnpm add @sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0 jq ' .metadata.component.version ' \ node_modules/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/dist/sbom.json # → "2.0.0" SBOM ni a ṣẹda pẹlu cyclonedx-npm lakoko opo iṣẹ tẹ jade. Ẹri npm Ohun elo ti a tẹ jade ni a fọwọsi nipa lilo ẹri package npm . O le ṣe idaniloju rẹ lẹhin ifisori ẹrọ pẹlu: npm view @sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0 --json | \ jq ' .dist."npm-signature" ' Ẹri ti a fọwọsi so tarball pada si iṣiṣẹ GitHub Actions gangan ti o ṣe agbejade rẹ. Awọn CVE ti a mọ & awọn atunṣe CVE Biba Ipo CVE-2023-44270 (postcss line return parsing) Alabọde Ti a ṣe atunṣe ninu v2.0.0 nipasẹ pnpm.overrides ti o mu postcss ga si ≥ 8.4.31 Ibi-ipamọ data imọran Snyk ati atokọ Awọn Imọran Aabo GitHub ni a ṣe abojuto nigbagbogbo; awọn atunṣe aabo ni a fi ranṣẹ bi awọn itusilẹ ipele-atunṣe . Jabo ailagbara kan Jọwọ maṣe ṣii ọran GitHub ti gbogbo eniyan fun ijabọ aabo. Dipo, lo ọna aṣiri ni: github.com/sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/security/advisories/new Awọn ijabọ ni a jẹwọ laarin wakati 72 ati atunṣe ni a fi ranṣẹ laarin ọjọ 14 fun awọn ọran alabọde, wakati 48 fun awọn ti o ṣe pataki. entries.content: Skip to main content 1. Ile-ikawe naa Skeletonic Stylus ni a fun ni iwe-aṣẹ meji labẹ Iwe-aṣẹ MIT ati Iwe-aṣẹ Apache 2.0 . O le lo, daakọ, ṣe atunṣe, dapọ, tẹ jade, pin, fun ni iwe-aṣẹ abẹlẹ, ati/tabi ta awọn ẹda ti software naa, ti o ba tẹle awọn ofin iwe-aṣẹ eyikeyi. A pese ile-ikawe naa "BI O TI RI", laisi oniduro iru eyikeyi , ti a ṣafihan tabi ti a tumọ si, pẹlu ṣugbọn kii ṣe opin si awọn oniduro ti ọja, ibamu fun idi kan pato, ati aisi irufin. 2. Aaye ayelujara yii Akoonu skeletonic.io (ọrọ, awọn apẹẹrẹ, awọn aworan iboju, awọn eto) jẹ Ẹtọ Ẹda © 2021 - 2026 Skeletonic CSS, gbogbo ẹtọ ni a pamọ, ti a si fun ni iwe-aṣẹ labẹ CC BY 4.0 — o le ṣe asọye, tumọ, tabi tun ṣe niwọn igba ti o ba ṣe itọkasi orisun. 3. Awọn ami iṣowo "Skeletonic" ati aami Skeletonic jẹ awọn ami iṣowo ti a ko forukọsilẹ ti Sebastien Rousseau. O le lo wọn lati tọka si iṣẹ-akanṣe naa, ṣugbọn jọwọ maṣe lo wọn ni ọna ti o dabi pe o n ṣe atilẹyin ọja ti ko ni ibatan. 4. entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Translation note (2026-04-30). v2.0.0 adds RTL support and a refreshed 2026 framework comparison. The English source is the canonical reference while these translations catch up. See https://skeletonic.io/about/ · https://skeletonic.io/components/ · https://skeletonic.io/benchmarks/ . Ni ṣoki Skeletonic Stylus jẹ ile-ikawe CSS Stylus orisun-ṣiṣi fun aṣa UI ti a le wọle si, ti o yara, ti o ni modulu. A bi i ni ọdun 2018 gẹgẹbi idanwo ti ara ẹni ninu fifiranṣẹ CSS ti o kere laisi fifun awọn ọna iṣẹ ti ile-ikawe paati gidi silẹ. Lẹhin ọdun mẹjọ, ibi-afẹde naa ko yipada. Ohun ti o fun ọ Iyara bi manamana Ṣe apẹrẹ ati ṣe aṣa awọn atọwọdọwọ ti o dahun ni awọn iṣẹju diẹ. Awọn oniyipada CSS abinibi, awọn kilasi ti a ti ṣeto tẹlẹ, grid ọwọn-12 ti o bo gbogbo ẹya HTML ti itumọ. Fẹẹrẹfẹ 8.0 KB gzipped. Awọn oju-iwe gba ni iyara ju. Gbogbo bulọọki ikọle pataki wa ninu. Apẹrẹ ti o dahun Ti a ṣe fun kọmputa ati alagbeka. Awọn eto mu ara wọn bamu si ẹrọ eyikeyi. Ti o dara fun ifọwọkan, HTML ti itumọ jakejado. Irayẹ-si WCAG 2.2 ti a fi sinu: awọn oruka focus-visible, iyatọ AA, awọn oluranlọwọ skip-link, awọn paati ti o rọrun fun itẹwe, atilẹyin idinku-iṣipopada — ko si iwe-aṣa afikun, ko si aria-* boilerplate. Ile-ikawe paati Awọn paati CSS modulu ati awọn adalu Stylus. Awọn bọtini, awọn fọọmu, awọn kaadi, awọn itaniji, awọn aami, awọn palẹti ati awọn ere idasọnu — mimọ, modulu, ti setan lati fi sii. Ọfẹ & orisun-ṣiṣi Ti Sebastien Rousseau ṣe apẹrẹ, kọ, ati ṣe itọju. Ti a fun ni iwe-aṣẹ meji labẹ MIT tabi Apache 2.0 . Ko si owo, ko si idiyele iwe-aṣẹ, paapaa fun lilo iṣowo. Bawo ni o ṣe fi wewe Iwe-aṣa ti ara ẹni kan bo iwe-kikọ, awọn bọtini, awọn fọọmu, awọn kaadi, awọn tabili, awọn palẹti, awọn ere idasọnu ati awọn kilasi iwulo. JavaScript kankan ko si. Ko si igbesẹ ikọ ti a beere. Ko si awọn igbarale ẹlẹgbẹ lori Bootstrap, Tailwind tabi Bulma. Ẹya Skeletonic Stylus Bootstrap 5 Tailwind CSS Bulma Iwọn gzipped 8.0 KB ~30 KB ~10 KB (varies) ~30 KB Ibamu WCAG 2.2 Ti a kọ sinu Apakan Afọwọṣe Apakan Awọn ipele cascade Bẹẹni ( @layer ) Rara Rara Rara Ipo dudu prefers-color-scheme Yiyan wọle Ipilẹ kilasi Yiyan wọle JavaScript nilo Rara Bẹẹni (Popper) Rara Rara CycloneDX SBOM Bẹẹni Rara Rara Rara Idinku iṣipopada Ti a bu ọla fun Apakan Afọwọṣe Apakan Iwe-aṣẹ MIT tabi Apache 2.0 MIT MIT MIT Awọn ilana Irayẹ-si ni ipilẹ, kii ṣe oke. Ibamu WCAG 2.2 ti a fi sinu gbogbo paati, a ko fi kun lẹhin bi "aṣa" kan. Awọn baiti ṣe pataki. Iwe-aṣa kan ti a firanṣẹ ko yẹ ki o bọ isuna iwuwo oju-iwe rẹ. Opin 8 KB gzipped ni a fi ipa mu ninu CI. Awọn ipele cascade bori ogun specificity. Ṣe atunṣe ohunkohun pẹlu igboya — ko si !important , ko si awọn ẹtan aṣẹ-DOM. Stylus si dara. Kukuru, ifarahan, o si jẹ ki ile-ikawe wa ninu ~3,000 awọn ila ti a le ka. Aibikita jẹ ẹya. Ko si awọn igbarale JS. Ko si idan akoko-ikọ. Ko si awọn iyipada orukọ ti o fọ. Awọn kilasi CSS ti o ṣe ohun ti wọn sọ gangan. Ti a le ṣe aṣa ni iṣẹju-aaya. Awọn ohun-ini aṣa CSS abinibi fun awọn awọ, aaye, iru ati radii. Ẹwọn-ipese ti a fi okun mu. Ẹri npm ti a fọwọsi. Awọn imudojuiwọn Dependabot ti a fi idi mulẹ. CVE-2023-44270 ti a ṣe atunṣe nipasẹ overrides. Ẹya ati semver Skeletonic Stylus tẹle Semantic Versioning 2.0 . Ilọsiwaju Nigba ti Apẹẹrẹ Pataki Yiyọ tabi tunlorukọ kilasi gbogbo eniyan, adalu, tabi ami 1.x → 2.0 Kekere Fifikun paati tuntun, adalu, tabi ami 1.1 → 1.2 Atunṣe Awọn atunṣe aṣiṣe, imudara a11y, iṣẹ-ṣiṣe, aabo 1.1.6 → 2.0.0 Gbogbo orukọ kilasi gbogbo eniyan, gbogbo awọn ohun-ini aṣa CSS, ati gbogbo awọn adalu Stylus ti a kojade jẹ apakan ti API gbogbo eniyan. Iyipada ti o fọ nkan ni ere ilọsiwaju pataki ati itọsọna iṣiwa. Iṣakoso Skeletonic Stylus ni a ṣe apẹrẹ, kọ, ati ṣe itọju nipasẹ Sebastien Rousseau . Ti a fun ni iwe-aṣẹ meji labẹ MIT ati Apache 2.0 . Awọn ọran, awọn ero, ati awọn ilowosi ni a kaabo — wo itọsọna ilowosi . ↑ ↓ Navigate ↵ Open Esc Close

entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Skeletonic Stylus v2.0.0 fi awọn palẹti awọ yan mẹta ranṣẹ, ọkọọkan ni a pin bi iwe-aṣa ti a dinku tirẹ nitorinaa o san fun ohun ti o lo nikan. Palẹti Faili Iwọn (min) Material dist/css/palettes/material/skeletonic-material.min.css ≈17.4 KB Tachyons dist/css/palettes/tachyons/skeletonic-tachyons.min.css 7.3 KB Aabo wẹẹbu dist/css/palettes/websafe/skeletonic-websafe.min.css ≈3.5 KB Oju-iwe yii n gba palẹti Tachyons nitorinaa awọn kilasi iwulo awọ ni isalẹ ṣe afihan ni deede. Awọn awọ-grẹy ipilẹ Skeletonic Iwe-aṣa ipilẹ fi iwọn grẹy igbesẹ-11 ti a le wọle si ranṣẹ ti a ṣafihan bi --cl-grey-100 … --cl-grey-1000 . 100 300 500 700 200 400 600 900 Awọn awọ ami iyasọtọ (v2.0.0 — iyatọ AA) Ninu v2.0.0 awọn ami akọkọ ati keji ni a ṣe dudu lati pade WCAG 4.5:1 iyatọ si ọrọ funfun lẹsẹkẹsẹ. --cl-primary hsl(210 100% 42%) --cl-secondary hsl(195 100% 33%) --cl-tertiary #757c8a Akiyesi. --cl-tertiary (#757c8a) ni ipin iyatọ ti 4.71:1 si funfun — o ni ibamu AA fun ọrọ nla (o kere ju 18 px nipọn / o kere ju 24 px deede) ṣugbọn kii ṣe fun ọrọ ara. Ṣe daapọ rẹ pẹlu awọn ipilẹ dudu tabi lo fun awọn ẹya ọṣọ ti kii ṣe pataki nikan. Awọn kilasi iwulo palẹti Tachyons Nigba ti o ba gba skeletonic-tachyons.min.css o gba eto pipe ti awọn kilasi awọ idi-kan — ohun kanna ti a fi ranṣẹ, modulu yan. < span class =" bg-blue white pa2 ">.bg-blue .white</ span > < span class =" bg-light-green dark-green pa2 ">.bg-light-green .dark-green</ span > < span class =" bg-washed-yellow dark-gray pa2 ">.bg-washed-yellow .dark-gray</ span > Pato palẹti Tachyons ni kikun ni a ṣe akọsilẹ ni tachyons.io/docs/themes/skins ; ẹya ti a fi ranṣẹ nibi ni eyi ti Skeletonic ṣajọ. entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Ni ṣoki skeletonic.io ko ṣeto awọn kuki ilepa ati pe ko ṣiṣẹ ami itẹle ẹnikẹta. Aaye yii jẹ eto HTML, CSS, ati faili service-worker kan ti o duro ṣinṣin. Ko si ibeere ti o ṣe ti a kọ silẹ ju awọn akọọlẹ wiwọle GitHub Pages lọ. Data wo ni a gba Awọn akọọlẹ wiwọle GitHub Pages. Nigba ti o ba gba oju-iwe eyikeyi, GitHub kọ adirẹsi IP rẹ, URL ibeere, ati akoko silẹ. Eto imulo asiri GitHub kan — wo docs.github.com/en/site-policy . Fọọmu olubasọrọ. Ti o ba fi fọọmu ranṣẹ lori /yo/kan-si-wa/ , data naa kọja nipasẹ Formspree , ti o firanṣẹ si imeeli olutọju. Eto imulo asiri Formspree kan. Service worker. Iwe afọwọkọ sw.js fi awọn idahun HTML, CSS, JS, ati aworan pamọ ni agbegbe ninu aṣawakiri rẹ nitorinaa aaye naa ṣiṣẹ ni alaisiasopọ. Ko si ohun ti a firanṣẹ si ibi kankan. Ohun ti a ko gba Ko si Google Analytics, Plausible, Fathom, tabi ami itẹle miiran. Ko si awọn kuki iru eyikeyi. Aaye naa ko ṣeto kankan. Ko si ibi-ipamọ agbegbe tabi IndexedDB ju kaṣi service-worker lọ. Ko si iṣe idanimọ, awọn nẹtiwọọki ipolowo, tabi awọn oluṣeto ẹnikẹta. Awọn ẹtọ rẹ Ti o ba ti lo fọọmu olubasọrọ ti o si fẹ ki a pa ifiranṣẹ rẹ rẹ, fi imeeli ranṣẹ lati adirẹsi ti o lo lati fi ranṣẹ, ati pe emi yoo pa a rẹ laarin ọjọ 30. entries.title: Skeletonic Stylus
entries.content: Skip to main content Translation note (2026-04-30). v2.0.0 adds RTL support and a refreshed 2026 framework comparison. The English source is the canonical reference while these translations catch up. See https://skeletonic.io/about/ · https://skeletonic.io/components/ · https://skeletonic.io/benchmarks/ . Ifihan Ṣe o tuntun si Skeletonic Stylus? Ninu v2.0.0 o rọrun ju ti tẹlẹ lọ lati yan awọn ẹya ti o nilo nikan. O ṣeun si iwọn kekere rẹ (8.0 KB gzipped fun iwe-aṣa akọkọ), o darapọ mọ ohun elo wẹẹbu eyikeyi ni kiakia — ko si ilana JavaScript ti a beere, ko si igbesẹ ikọ ti a nilo ti o ba lo CDN. Ṣe o setan lati fi sori ẹrọ? Gbogbo ọna ni a ṣe alaye ni isalẹ — yan eyi ti o ba ọ mu. 1. Gba silẹ ki o si fi sori ẹrọ O le fi Skeletonic Stylus sori ẹrọ nipasẹ pnpm , npm tabi yarn , tabi gba a taara lati CDN. O tun le gbalejo awọn faili pinpin ni agbegbe ti o ba fẹ. Lati oluṣakoso package (ti a ṣe iṣeduro) # pnpm pnpm add @sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0 # npm npm install @sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0 # yarn yarn add @sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0 Lati CDN Ti o ba nilo CSS ti a ṣajọ nikan, fi ọkan ninu iwọnyi sinu <head> rẹ: <!-- jsDelivr --> < link rel =" stylesheet " href =" https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0/dist/css/core/skeletonic.min.css " crossorigin =" anonymous "> <!-- unpkg --> < link rel =" stylesheet " href =" https://unpkg.com/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0/dist/css/core/skeletonic.min.css " crossorigin =" anonymous "> Fun iduroṣinṣin ti o pọ julọ, daakọ SRI hash lati awọn akọsilẹ itusilẹ v2.0.0 ki o fi ẹya integrity="sha384-…" kun. Awọn ipo CDN miiran CDN URL HTTPS Apapọ jsDelivr https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0/dist/css/core/skeletonic.min.css Bẹẹni Bẹẹni unpkg https://unpkg.com/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0/dist/css/core/skeletonic.min.css Bẹẹni Rara Gba itusilẹ GitHub Ṣe o fẹ tarball ti a ṣe ẹya? Gba itusilẹ tuntun lati github.com/sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/releases ki o fi awọn akoonu dist/ taara sinu iṣẹ-akanṣe rẹ. Ṣe daakọ ibi-ipamọ GitHub Ṣe daakọ ibi-ipamọ akọkọ lati gba gbogbo awọn faili orisun pẹlu awọn iwe afọwọkọ ikọ: git clone https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus.git cd skeletonic-stylus pnpm install pnpm run build Imọran: fọwọsi awọn adehun rẹ — iṣẹ-akanṣe naa fi ipa mu awọn adehun ti a fọwọsi ninu CI. Lo git commit -S -m "..." (tabi ṣeto commit.gpgsign = true ninu git config gbogbogbo rẹ). 2. Lo CSS ti a ṣajọ Ile-ikawe naa fi ọpọlọpọ awọn akopọ ti a ti kọ tẹlẹ ranṣẹ labẹ dist/css/ lẹhin ifisori ẹrọ: Faili Idi Iwọn (min/gz) core/skeletonic.min.css Atunṣeto + awọn ami + eto + awọn ẹya + awọn paati + awọn iwulo 40.6 KB / 8.0 KB animations/skeletonic-animations.min.css Modulu ere idasọnu yan ≈213 KB / ≈6.9 KB palettes/material/skeletonic-material.min.css Palẹti awọ Material ≈17.4 KB palettes/tachyons/skeletonic-tachyons.min.css Palẹti iwulo Tachyons 7.3 KB palettes/websafe/skeletonic-websafe.min.css Palẹti aabo wẹẹbu ≈3.5 KB Modulu kọọkan jẹ ominira — yan apapọ ti o kere julọ ti o nilo. 3. Lo o lati Stylus Ti o ba ni opo Stylus tẹlẹ, o le mu awọn modulu orisun wọle ki o jẹ ki bundler rẹ yọ awọn apakan ti a ko lo kuro: // styles/main.styl @import '~@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/src/stylus/skeletonic' Tabi mu awọn apakan ti o nilo nikan wọle: @import '~@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/src/stylus/utilities/variables' @import '~@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/src/stylus/utilities/mixins' @import '~@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/src/stylus/elements/buttons' @import '~@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus/src/stylus/components/card' 4. Ṣe atunṣe awọ ami iyasọtọ Skeletonic ṣafihan awọn ami apẹrẹ rẹ bi awọn ohun-ini aṣa CSS nitorinaa o le ṣe aṣa rẹ laisi atunṣe Stylus: : root { --cl-primary: hsl ( 210 , 100% , 42% ); --cl-secondary: hsl ( 195 , 100% , 33% ); --cl-tertiary: #757c8a ; } Iyẹn ni — gbogbo paati ti o lo awọ akọkọ yoo tẹle. 5. Ṣe idaniloju ifisori ẹrọ Ayẹwo "ṣe o ṣiṣẹ?" ti o kere julọ: <! doctype html> < html lang =" yo "> < head > < meta charset =" utf-8 "> < link rel =" stylesheet " href =" https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@sebastienrousseau/skeletonic-stylus@2.0.0/dist/css/core/skeletonic.min.css "> </ head > < body class =" container padding-3 "> < h1 >O n ṣiṣẹ.</ h1 > < a href =" # " class =" button primary ">Pẹlẹ o, agbaye</ a > </ body > </ html > Ti akọle ba ti ni iwọn ni irọrun ti bọtini si ni apẹrẹ egbogi buluu, o ti pari. 6. Ohun ti o wa ninu Ninu package naa iwọ yoo ri gbogbo faili orisun, awọn akopọ CSS ti a ṣajọ ati ti a dinku, awọn maapu orisun, ati igi Stylus kan ti a ṣeto nipasẹ ẹka:

Awọn ibeere ti a ma n beere nigbagbogbo
Lati oluṣakoso package (ti a ṣe iṣeduro)
